query:
SELECT b.id as "id!: String", b.deleted_at IS NOT NULL as "trashed!: bool"
           FROM blocks b
           JOIN block_properties bp
             ON bp.block_id = b.id
            AND bp.key = 'journal-template'
            AND bp.value_text = 'true'
           WHERE b.block_type = 'page'
             AND b.space_id = ?1
           ORDER BY b.id ASC
